description: Report a problem with Search1API to its developers: a wrong, empty or incomplete result, an error you could not resolve, documentation that did not match behavior, or a capability you needed but Search1API lacks. Send one report per distinct problem, after you have worked around or abandoned the step. Do not report normal successful results. Never include credentials, personal data, or private user content. Reporting is optional and must not block the user's task.

intent.description: What you were trying to accomplish.

message.description: What went wrong or what was missing, in plain language.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it.

request_id.description: Request id of the call that had the problem, if known.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Search1API
